verdict.rationale: Working Copy is a mobile git client that can create what appear to be pull requests for BitBucket, GitHub and GitLab, though the docs snippet never names them explicitly. Its review-adjacent tools are documented: syntax-highlighted file viewing, diffs with hunk-level detail, image diff comparison and a cross-branch commit graph, so you can inspect proposed changes on a phone. Nothing shows a true PR review workflow inside the app. Missing for 10: listing and opening incoming pull requests, inline review comments, approve/request-changes actions, merging PRs from the app, and independent corroboration of PR review on mobile.
